title: Industrial Designer
note: Open to recent grads with internship experience (or 1-3 years); apply by email with portfolio, cover letter and resume; US work authorization required.

facts.summary: Consultancy industrial designer role, contract-to-hire, team works mostly remotely.
facts.duties: Take products from concept through development, build presentations, check manufacturability, work with engineering and vendor teams.
facts.requirements: 1-3 years or recent grad with internships; sketching, model making, SolidWorks, Rhino, KeyShot, Illustrator, Photoshop.
facts.apply: Email info@hatchduo.com with portfolio (required), cover letter and resume.
